issues.title: No-progress and end-state API retries required controller hardening
issues.detail: A stalled assigned target could starve idle attackers, and a final API census could race the mission end state. The controller now performs bounded no-progress reallocation and preserves the successful typed census/native snapshot before terminal API closure.
issues.nextAction: None; retain the bounded retry and terminal snapshot contract in future modifiers.
